item.title: a small guide to service workers
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I spent a while getting service workers wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Service workers shows up across web work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: a small guide to service workers
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months service workers bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Service workers shows up across web work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
